verses.text: Ayik 14 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Ezequías reyal, hata' ix syamoch winhaj Senaquerib sreyal Asiria yak'an owal t'a masanil chonhab' ayoch smuroal t'a yol yik Judá, ix ak'ji ganar juntzanh chonhab' chi' yuj winh.

Wanto yak'an owal winh t'a Laquis, ix schekankot jun yajalil heb' soldado winh yet' jun niwan nhilanh heb' soldado t'a winhaj rey Ezequías t'a Jerusalén. Ix jawi winh b'aj tz'emul yok ha ha' t'a jun yet'tal t'a yib'anh, b'aj sb'at b'e sk'och b'aj sjuk'chaj k'apak k'apak.

Ha winhaj Eliaquim yuninal winhaj Hilcías yilumal tastak ay t'a winh rey, winhaj Sebna tz'ib'um yet' winhaj Joa yuninal winhaj Asaf stz'ib'an yab'ixal winh rey chi', ix elta heb' winh scha winh yajalil heb' soldado chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Alek juntzanh lolonel tik t'a winhaj Ezequías, to a winh sreyal Asiria ek'b'al te niwan yelk'ochi, a winh tz'alan icha tik: ¿Tas ayoch yipok a k'ool?
¿Tom tza na' to yujnhej lolonel wach' yalji, sb'at heb' in soldado jelan yak'an owal elelal tza na'a? ¿Mach tzak'och yipok a k'ool, yuj chi' te winak tzutej a b'a t'a wichanh?

Ha swilani to a Egipto tzak'och yipok a k'ool. Ichokab' ta', palta a Egipto chi', lajan wal icha junok te' aj kanhchajnak, ayik tzonh och yub'naj t'a snhi' te', sb'at tz'isnaj te' t'a ko k'ab'. Icha chi' yaj winh sreyal Egipto chi' t'a mach tz'ak'anoch winh yipok sk'ool.

Ach Ezequías, tekan tzal icha tik: Ha onh tik a Jehová ko Diosal skak'och yipok ko k'ool. Palta ina toxo ix a chek satjiel juntzanh altar b'aj chaanh, b'aj tz'och heb' anima ejmelal t'a jun he Diosal chi'. Ix halani to junxonhej altar b'aj tz'och heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Jerusalén ejmelal.

Ha tiknaik b'o junok a trato yet' winh wajalil, haton winh sreyal Asiria. Syal winh t'ayach icha tik: Ol wak' chab'ok mil nok' chej t'ayach, tato tz'ilchaj heb' soldado sk'e t'a yib'anh nok' uuj. ¿Tom ol yal uuj?
Tato icha chi', ¿tom ol tzak'wan eyak'an owal yet' jun nhilanh heb' ko soldado aj Asiria wanto sk'ayi, wach'chom tze komon ak'ejoch heb' aj Egipto yet' skarruaje yipok he k'ool?

Hanhejtona', ¿tom tza na' to tzonh komon jawi ko satel jun chonhab' tik tato manhok Jehová ayoch ket'ok? Haton wal ix onh chekankot ul ex ko sateli, xchikot winh rey, xchi winh yajalil heb' soldado chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliaquim, winhaj Sebna yet' winhaj Joa t'a jun winh yajalil heb' soldado chi' icha tik: --Sko k'an t'ayach to ha t'a ti' arameo tzach loloni, yujto skab'pax a onh tik. Manh al t'a ti' hebreo yik max yab' masanil heb' anima ayk'e t'a yib'anh smuroal chonhab' tik, xchi heb' winh.

Palta ix yalan winh yajalil heb' soldado chi' icha tik: --Manhoknhej t'a winh eyajalil yet' t'ayex ix in chekjikot yuj winh sreyal Asiria wal jun tik, palta ix in chekjikot ul wal t'a masanil anima ayk'e t'a yib'anhtak smuroal chonhab' tik, ajun pax heb' ol ab'an syail heyet'ok, yujto ol he lo he tza', ol eyuk'anpax he chul, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix k'e linhan winh yajal chi', ix awaj chaanh winh, ix yalan winh t'a ti' hebreo: --Ab'ek wal tas syal winh rey ek'b'al te niwan yelk'ochi, haton winh sreyal Asiria:
Manh eyak' he b'a ak'jok musansatil yuj winhaj Ezequías chi', yujto manh ol yal ex skolan winh t'a yol in k'ab', xchi winh rey chi'.

Tato syal winhaj Ezequías chi' to anhej Jehová tzeyak'och yipok he k'ool, syalan winh t'ayex icha tik: Wal yel ol onh skol Jehová ko Diosal, manh ol scha ak'jok ganar ko chonhab' tik yuj winh sreyal Asiria, tato xchi winh,

manh he cha eyab' t'a winh. Yujto a winh sreyal Asiria chi' ix in chekankot wal t'ayex to tzex och t'a junk'olal yet' winh, tzeyak'anoch he b'a t'a yol sk'ab' winh yik wach' ol he lo sat te' eyuwa yet' sat te' higo, ol eyuk'anpax ha ha' eyiktaxoni,
masanto ol ex yik'b'at winh t'a jun lum lum icha wal lum eyik tik, syak' ixim trigo yet' te' uwa t'a lu'um. Ol he b'o ixim pan, ol he b'oanpax wino.

Tato syal winhaj Ezequías chi' to a Jehová ol ex kolanok, manh eyak' he b'a smusej he sat winh. ¿Tokwal ay junok sdiosal juntzanhxo chonhab' ix yal skolan schonhab' t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Asiria chi'?
¿B'ajtil ix k'ochkan sdiosal chonhab' Hamat yet' chonhab' Arfad? ¿B'ajtil ix k'ochkan sdiosal chonhab' Sefarwaim? ¿Tokwal ay junok Dios ix kolan Samaria t'a yol sk'ab' winh rey chi'?
¿Mach junok sdiosal juntzanh chonhab' chi' ix yal skolan schonhab' t'a yol sk'ab' winh? ¿Tas yuj tze na' to a Jehová ol kolanel Jerusalén tik t'a yol sk'ab' winh? xchi winh yajalil heb' soldado chi'.
Numanxonhej ix ajkan heb' anima chi, malaj junok heb' ix halan junok b'elanh lolonel, yujto ix yal winhaj Ezequías chi' to malaj junok heb' stak'wi.

Yuj chi' a winhaj Eliaquim, winhaj Sebna yet' winhaj Joa chi', ix snhik'chitejb'at spichul heb' winh, ix b'at heb' winh yal t'a winhaj Ezequías masanil tas ix yal winh yajalil heb' soldado aj Asiria chi'.
